name: serverless
title: Serverless
summary: Pick your cloud once, and your agents never drift from it.

rules.text: Every function has an alarm before it ships.
rules.why: a function that fails quietly is found by your users first.

rules.text: No function runs past its platform's time limit.
rules.why: the platform stops a function at its limit, so longer work has to be split before it fails in production.

items.title: Every function has an alarm
items.criterion: The infrastructure code defines an error alarm for every function it deploys. test/alarms.test.js reads the infrastructure definition, fails on a function without an alarm, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- the infrastructure definition
- test/alarms.test.js
Test:
- test/alarms.test.js lists every function in the infrastructure definition and fails on one without an error alarm

items.title: Every function stops before its platform's time limit
items.criterion: Every function sets a timeout below the time limit of the platform it runs on. test/timeouts.test.js reads each function's timeout and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- the infrastructure definition
- test/timeouts.test.js
Test:
- test/timeouts.test.js compares each function's timeout with its platform's limit
